source: (async(tab,id,text)=>{const h=eval(load("helpers"));await h.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").closest('.select__control').scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'instant'});true");await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_open({tabId:tab});const r=await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_click({tabId:tab,selector:'.select__control:has([id="'+id+'"]) button'});if(r.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(r));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const opts=await h.ev(tab,"[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].filter(e=>e.id.startsWith('react-select')).map(e=>({id:e.id,text:e.innerText}))");const o=opts.find(e=>e.text===text);if(!o)throw Error(JSON.stringify(opts));await h.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(o.id)+").click();true");await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));await h.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").blur();true");return h.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").closest('.select__control').innerText");})
note: Inspected DOM options only, delays and focus, exact-match selection. Does not submit.
